academicIntegrityPolicy.summary: Your essay must be independently produced, sources must be acknowledged, and unauthorized AI drafting or substantive rewriting is not permitted. This editor records selected writing-process events and embeds them in the exported DOCX.
academicIntegrityPolicy.attestationText: I confirm that this is my own work, that I have acknowledged outside sources and any AI assistance as required by my teacher and school policy, and that I understand the file includes an editing history of this session.
